title: AI Action Scene Workflow: Blender to Higgsfield Seedance 2.5
description: Turn basic low-poly animation into a high-octane ninja fight sequence along Torii gate paths. See how 3D camera tracking and blocking guide AI video generation for hyper-consistent action choreography. Watch the full breakdown in the linked related video!
